lines.say: This is for the person who skips the last question on the past paper.
Skipping it felt fine. Everyone does this.
But knowing a topic isn't scoring on it.
Most of us practise the questions we can already do.
That blank box is the actual revision.
Offload builds the plan from your notes and exam dates.
It tests you with exam-style questions, and brings weak ones back.
You just click the link in your calendar and show up.
Tag the one who skips it.
